assembly_dir.ask: Folder holding Thermo.TNG.Factory.dll, API-2.0.dll and Fusion.API-1.0.dll
assembly_dir.help: The licensed IAPI assemblies from Thermo (not redistributable). Fusion.API-2.0.dll replaces Fusion.API-1.0.dll on Tune 4.3; rename or edit ASSEMBLIES in driver.py in that case.

data_dir.ask: Folder where custom-scan centroid lists are written as CSV

instrument_index.ask: Instrument index on this PC (1 unless several instruments are attached)

connect_timeout_s.ask: Seconds to wait for the IAPI service to connect

scan_timeout_s.ask: Seconds to wait for a requested custom scan beyond its injection time
